sentences.text: For a floating-rate business loan sanctioned on or after 1 January 2026, a Tier 3 UCB may levy pre-payment charges only under the residual rule where the specific no-charge rules do not apply, and for those cases the charges, if any, must be as per the UCB’s approved policy. [E8, E1]

The specific Tier 3 no-charge rule for business-purpose loans to individuals and Micro and Small Enterprises applies only up to a sanctioned amount/limit of ₹50 lakh, and this loan is ₹60 lakh, so that specific no-charge rule does not apply here. [E6, R4]

Any pre-payment charge must be disclosed in the sanction letter and loan agreement, and if KFS is required it must also be mentioned there; a charge that has not been disclosed cannot be charged. [E12, E13, E14]

missing.slot: approved policy permitting a pre-payment charge
missing.searched: No evidence was provided showing the UCB’s approved policy for this loan.
